normal.name: Chris Jags
normal.text: I don't feel like this year has been an exceptional video game year. Of what I've played, I've only liked a handful. I HAVE enjoyed Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, Final Fantasy Resonance, and Well Dweller, but nothing wowed me like some of last year's faves like Clair Obscur. The only AAA I played, Pragmata, had (IMO) such boring characters I shut it off. I might like the two Star Wars games, but I'm not interested until a good sale comes along. Anyways, what's YOUR take on #gaming this year?

normal.text: Well, Actually: a free printable myths game from The Humanual. 24 cards, 2 to 20 players. Read a card aloud, everyone votes true or myth, then flip it. normal.name: Jakob Fel
normal.text: These days, GOG has an "additional contribution" option when purchasing anything. Today, I tried something new: I've decided that, going forward, I'll be rounding up all of my orders to the nearest whole dollar. I'm not buying much these days (for various reasons) but rounding up contributes a few cents each time. That's not a huge contribution but if we all started doing that to our orders, that still helps to support GOG's game preservation efforts over time. #gog #drmfree #RetroGames

heated.name: Victor Barreiro Jr.
heated.text: A question because I'm curious about something i want to do. There's this banger Korean fansong about #CrimsonDesert made with AI... and while I'm normally AI-resistant, I found myself enamored by the backing track and the loose translation, so much that I asked the guy who uploaded it if the backing track is available. I want to make an English cover where I sing my version. The Question: What passes for "transformative enough" here when it comes to doing song covers? #videogames #singing

heated.name: .:\dGh/:.
heated.text: There is a difference in #AI usage people don't get. Being assisted by AI is totally fine. Studios will say "NO AI WAS USED" but we know it's true. Exporting assets made entirely by AI (aka #GenAI) is what removes value to the product. Are you buying a human-made product, or a sloppy crash grab? What's the difference? #Videogames #Gaming #Games #ArtificialIntelligence #VideogameDevelopment
